purpose: Select the smallest L=5/L=13 sentinel matrix that distinguishes persistent monotone flow, red-frontier growth, finite-size curvature, and order-one saturation using the existing Bayesian posterior.

selection_rule.curvature_sentinel: choose a high-event cell with large Pr(H_other|data) and an interior L=9 extremum; exclude low-event zero plateaus
selection_rule.saturation_sentinel: choose a high-event, near-flat cell with high posterior entropy to test persistence of an order-one plateau

excluded_as_shot_limited.rule: Do not spend new distances on cells with zero logical events at every existing size; their ordering uncertainty is event-limited rather than evidence of curvature.

selected_cells.prediction: L=5 and L=13 should extend the decreasing order if the high-q green region is a persistent size effect.
L=5 and L=13 should either push Pr(H_increasing|data) through 0.90 or expose large-size turnover.
Outer distances discriminate a persistent L=9 hump from a three-size fluctuation.
L=5 and L=13 test whether the near-one-half LER is a persistent order-one plateau rather than an unresolved directional trend.

evidence_boundary: This selection is a bounded sentinel experiment. It does not fill the full q-p grid, promote a boundary, or classify an asymptotic phase.
